description: Compare each station's average bandwidth usage with the mean bandwidth usage over all individual telescopes.

b.request: For observatory stations whose average telescope bandwidth usage exceeds the global mean bandwidth usage across all telescopes, report the mean bandwidth usage of those stations and the mean excess above the global average for those stations, both unrounded.
b.sql:
WITH global_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as global_mean
  FROM telescopes
),
station_avg AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as station_mean
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
above_global AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.station_mean,
    sa.station_mean - ga.global_mean as excess
  FROM station_avg sa, global_avg ga
  WHERE sa.station_mean > ga.global_mean
)
SELECT 
  AVG(station_mean) as mean_bandwidth_usage,
  AVG(excess) as mean_excess
FROM above_global
b.raw: For observatory stations whose average telescope bandwidth usage exceeds the global mean bandwidth usage across all telescopes, report the mean bandwidth usage of those stations and the mean excess above the global average for those stations, both unrounded.

c.request: For observatory stations whose average telescope bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) is above average, what is their mean bandwidth usage, and how far above average are they on average? Ignore missing usage values, and give both figures unrounded in a single row. Compare each station's average bandwidth usage with the mean bandwidth usage over all individual telescopes.
c.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as overall_mean FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL),station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as station_mean FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation),above_avg_stations AS (SELECT sa.station_mean FROM station_avg sa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE sa.station_mean > oa.overall_mean)SELECT AVG(station_mean) as mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(station_mean) - (SELECT overall_mean FROM overall_avg) as above_average_amount FROM above_avg_stations;

d.request: For observatory stations whose mean bandwidth usage (averaged from their constituent telescopes) exceeds the global mean bandwidth usage across all telescopes, report the mean bandwidth usage of those stations and the mean amount by which they exceed the global mean, both unrounded.
d.sql:
WITH global_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as global_avg
  FROM telescopes
),
station_means AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
)
SELECT 
  AVG(sm.station_avg) as mean_bandwidth_of_exceeding_stations,
  AVG(sm.station_avg - gm.global_avg) as mean_excess_amount
FROM station_means sm, global_mean gm
WHERE sm.station_avg > gm.global_avg

a.request: Average the bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) of the telescopes at each observatory station, ignoring missing values. Take as the baseline the average bandwidth usage over all telescopes (each telescope counting once). For the stations whose average is above that baseline, return one row with two unrounded values: the mean of those stations' averages, and the mean amount by which they exceed the baseline.
a.sql:
WITH station_avgs AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as baseline_val
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
),
above_baseline AS (
  SELECT sa.station_avg, sa.station_avg - b.baseline_val as excess
  FROM station_avgs sa
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE sa.station_avg > b.baseline_val
)
SELECT 
  AVG(station_avg) as mean_of_station_averages,
  AVG(excess) as mean_excess
FROM above_baseline
